integration_notes: Infills alone do not reclassify a simple job.
Solid common rafters 50x50 up to 4m per-plane span, 80x50 above; 600mm maximum framing centres; 50x50 purlins.
Gable ridges over 6m use 150x50x3 steel; freestanding corner piles include 1.4m embedment and approved foundation allowances. Published v2.8 and older controls retain their semantics.
